notes: Summary: High-sensitivity government research authority responsible for regional satellite ops and emergency response coordination. Interested in fully air-gapped Private deployment with HSM-backed key management, strict data residency, and IL5/IL6 controls.

Contact history: Met at GovTech symposium (2025-10). AE intro call 2025-11-12 — primary technical sponsor: Dir. of IT Ops (name withheld). Follow-up procurement workshop 2026-02-18 with SE and security team.
Quote from call: 'We need an inference stack we can accredit and cut a cert path to — no internet egress is non-negotiable.'

Workload profile: mix of chat-like analyst assistants (short-turn latency), nightly bulk embeddings for classified archive search, and reranking pipelines for prioritized alert triage. Peak concurrency expected 200-400 qps for embeddings batch jobs, 80 concurrent low-latency chat sessions for analysts.

Performance targets: 95th percentile latency <120ms for 512-token single-turn chat in local LAN; embeddings batch throughput target 1M vectors/day with GPU quantized pipelines; deterministic cold-start behavior required for audits.
Model preferences: leaning to vetted open LLMs with quantization (4-bit/8-bit) and provenance; willingness to accept Redwood-verified variants. No external model hosting (must run inside enclave).
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to CPU-only compatible model for maintenance windows; prefer on-prem variant selection policies and deterministic rollbacks for audits.

Security asks: SSO/SAML integration with existing IdP, signed audit logs shipped to internal SIEM, long-term retention controls (7+ years for audit logs), HSM/KMS for key custody, scanned SBOM and CVE triage process.

POC plan: 8-week air-gapped pilot — week 0: site survey and DOA approval; week 1-2: provisioning hardware (Redwood provided image), week 3: offline install & validation, week 4-6: workload ingestion and evaluator tests (quality/regression), week 7-8: accreditation pack & go/no-go review.

Acceptance criteria for POC: pass offline inference conformance suite, deterministic audit logs for all requests, SSO with IdP via isolated connector, model quality within 8% of baseline prompts, operator-run failover test completed.

Commercial notes: procurement asks firm fixed price for initial Private appliance + 12-month support; potential renewal to Dedicated if need for hybrid cloud arises. Budget runway expected within FY26 Q3.
Recent actions: SE delivered prelim security deck (drive link), security sent initial questionnaire 2026-02-25 (SEC-7120), Ops requested on-site install window options (two weeks in May).
Internal flags: heavy legal review expected (export controls), will require Redwood NDA amendment and STIG-like documentation.
